facts.business: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Limited (Groww) operates India's largest direct-to-customer digital investment platform offering mutual funds, stock broking, and wealth management services through mobile and web interfaces.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: General Information Technology (IT) Environment and accuracy of Revenue

key_risks: Complexity of IT systems and significance of volumes of data processed in revenue computation
Existence of presumed fraud risk in revenue recognition from subsidiaries
Dependence on subsidiaries' revenue for Company's revenue from operations
facts.related_party_note: Company earns income from subsidiaries as per agreements entered into with them; revenue from operations is dependent on revenue earned by subsidiaries
